node.control.progress.name: ProgressBar
node.control.progress.description: Display total and current counts as a progress bar, percentage and numbers. Integers and decimals can be mixed. Zero total displays 0%; overflow is capped at 100% on the bar. No outputs.
Progress requires two non-negative finit: Progress requires two non-negative finite numbers.
progress.invalid: Progress inputs must be non-negative finite numbers.
